overall_assessment: No personal-data leak is visible in the 28 fully read packet entries (20 suspects and eight random controls), and standard staff-name, approval, semester and cohort removals generally work. Visible phone-like numbers are publication dates, and name_like flags are explained by reference authors, organisations or subject terms; some phone triggers and both admin_date triggers are outside the truncated plan excerpts and cannot be classified conclusively from this packet. Confirmed defects affect three entries with residual administrative dating, including one random control, and one entry with a damaged content heading; they are occasional rather than institution-wide, subject to the supplied truncation limits.

findings.evidence: Godkjent av instituttleiar Godkjent av dekan 20.10. 2017 … 27.01.2014/dekan- godkjent i ledermøte
findings.description: Two approval-date formats survive: an internal space in 20.10. 2017 in the FM1DANS random control, and a date directly followed by /dekan in SMERTE100. The latter is visible as surviving context after a removed approval/name span, although its full plan tail is truncated. Both are institutional approval stamps that must be removed, not dates of government documents or publications. The random control shows that the pre-pass can miss this defect.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic() expects contiguous dd.mm.yyyy and rejects a following slash through (?![\d/]|...). The approval-specific short-date rule also does not accept these formats. Read-only calls to the current anonymize_text() reproduced both surviving stamps.
findings.suggested_fix: Add approval-context date matching for dd.mm. followed by horizontal whitespace and a four-digit year, and for dd.mm.yyyy immediately followed by /dekan or another recognised staff role. Preserve the government-document and bibliographic guards. Add regression cases for these two exact stamp formats and retained publication/regulation dates.

findings.description: The reading-list header retains the administrative semester label Høst-18. Other sampled labels such as Høst22 and Høst 25 are removed. This is a semester and year identifying the offering, not a season used as course content; it also escapes the pre-pass semester-date pattern.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic() permits only whitespace between a season word and a two- or four-digit year. The separate H/V code rule does not match the full word Høst. The current anonymize_text() leaves this header unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Allow an optional hyphen or dash, with horizontal whitespace, between a complete season word and its two- or four-digit semester year. Retain the credits and government-document guards. Add cases for Høst-18 and Vår-2022 alongside ordinary season words and vår meaning our.

findings.description: Surviving context in the Endringsbeskrivelse removal spans retains 2021 and 2020 in a note that one reading-list version replaces the other. These years date an administrative revision, followed by the programme coordinator/course leader signatures, rather than identifying publications in a reading list. Removing the signatures and entry dates leaves this separate administrative dating intact.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_generic() removes isolated administrative years only after a limited set of keywords, and .anon_usn() has no rule for revision-note years in Endringsbeskrivelse. The phrase erstatter lista fra does not match those year rules.
findings.suggested_fix: In USN Endringsbeskrivelse blocks, remove year values in explicitly identified list-replacement notes matching a year followed by erstatter lista fra and another year. Keep the note text and stop the block at the next section heading; preserve publication years in the actual Litteratur section.

findings.evidence: tilpassing av presbyope [−Journalføring−] føring og dokumentasjon (journalføring i kontaktlinsepraksis,
findings.description: The subject heading Journalføring og dokumentasjon is changed to føring og dokumentasjon. Journalføring means clinical record keeping and is course content, not a Leganto item-type label. The token-level diff displays the deleted original word and the replacement fragment; it does not indicate that a complete duplicate heading remains. No analogous content damage is visible in the other entries or random controls.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R .anon_usn() strips the line-initial Leganto type Journal before a lowercase continuation. Journal is absent from the alternatives that disallow lowercase continuations, and the suffix exclusions do not include føring. A read-only call to anonymize_text() reproduced Journalføring becoming føring.
findings.suggested_fix: Protect Journalføring and its inflections/compounds from the Journal item-type alternative, for example with Journal(?!føring), before applying the generic Leganto-prefix cleanup. Add a regression case preserving Journalføring og dokumentasjon and a positive case still stripping Journal from a genuine glued item-type label.
